g.text: Nominal mediation candidates; GO p-values use BH correction within each screen and ontology.
Background: all tested outcome genes in each target microenvironment.
Top three qualifying terms per screen; displayed dots require GO BH p < 0.05 and ≥2 candidate genes.
Separate backgrounds and annotation coverage can change gene-ratio denominators between screens.
